draft.text: I am releasing "From Token to Fleet," a technical reference that traces the engineering path from a single LLM token through to a coordinated GPU fleet. It details memory hierarchy management, kernel fusion, collective communication, and scheduling policies that make large‑scale training and serving deterministic. Engineers building or operating LLM infrastructure will find the concrete patterns and trade‑offs needed to scale reliably.
